title: What to expect from Link Permissions and Expiry

question.author: member_074
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for link permissions and expiry?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Links to folders inherit the folder's permissions. Share links can carry an optional expiration date and an optional password. Expired links stop working immediately, and you can revoke any link at any time from the Shared links panel. Changing a file's permissions applies to every link that points to it. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
